description: Official ChatGPT desktop app with Codex, unpacked from the Store-signed MSIX without AppX registration.
pre_install: Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'app\resources\cua_node\bin\node_modules') -Recurse -Force | Where-Object Name -Match '%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}' | Sort-Object { $_.FullName.Length } -Descending | ForEach-Object { Rename-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -NewName ([Uri]::UnescapeDataString($_.Name)) -ErrorAction Stop }

script: try { $versions = @('x64', 'arm64' | ForEach-Object { (& $reader -Uri "https://persistent.oaistatic.com/codex-app-prod/releases/$($release.buildVersion)/ChatGPT-$_.msix" -ErrorAction Stop).Version }) } catch { if ($_.Exception.GetBaseException().StatusCode -ne [System.Net.HttpStatusCode]::NotFound) { throw }; $expected_ver; return }

notes: CODEX_CLI_PATH is set automatically - it must point to the bundled CLI for this unpacked installation to start without MSIX package identity and keep desktop API compatibility.
Codex state remains in ~/.codex, %APPDATA%\Codex, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\OpenAI\Codex; Scoop does not move or delete it.
